title: X-NUCLEO-53L9A1
content: I purchased  X-NUCLEO-53L9A1 with NUCLEO-H563ZI as it was recommended by ST. I just want to load the binary and see a simple ranging output value array. The binary provided didn´t work. Now it seams like they recommend  Nucleo N657X0. Could please someone clarify what board should I use so that there is a working binary provided?

scraped_replies.html: Yes, I saw, it didn´t work.

Hi:

Actually, we both support L9 with STM32H5 and STM32N6. but L9 with STM32N6 is developing currently and not release officially.

For your L9 with STM32H5 platform. please download the driver from: X-CUBE-53L9A1 | Product - STMicroelectronics. 

And following Getting started with X-CUBE-53L9A1: Direct ToF lidar sensor software expansion for STM32Cube - User manual to setup (hardware and software) and compile and flash the sample applications.

Maybe there is a litter bit complex. if have any questions, please add comments and reply to me.

Best regards,

Bin FAN
